symbols.name: ground-set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements in the ground set $[h] = \{1, \dots, h\}$, which is 100 in the construction.
symbols.quote: Let $h$ be the number of elements in the ground set, so that the ground set is $[h] = \{1, \dots, h\}$; the construction uses $h = 100$.

symbols.name: triple
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: Let $T$ be a three-element subset of $[h]$, called a triple.

symbols.name: triple indicator vector
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector of the triple $T$: the 0-1 vector with entry 1 exactly at the positions of the elements of $T$.
symbols.quote: Its indicator vector $t_T$ has an entry $1$ in each position $i \in T$ and $0$ in every other position.

relations.predicate: has one entry per element of
relations.quote: Each indicator vector has one entry per element of the ground set.
